objective: PR8 code (worktree pr8, branch release/0.2.0/feat/collaborative-intents, based on PR7): collaborative Intents in the CLI, hooks and skills.
constraints: Follow the ship brief and AGENTS.md (Effect, Schema with onExcessProperty error, JSDoc).
Committed records stay free of absolute paths and machine-specific data.
acceptance_criteria: local/ gets its own .gitignore containing * whenever the CLI creates it.
Intent records carry state open|closed with a close reason; absent state decodes as open.
intent close --reason refuses while an Assignment of that Intent is Running; intent reopen returns it to open and bumps its revision; a closed Intent never authorizes a dispatch.
intent list prints id, state, revision, objective and open-Assignment count, with --state.

intent use <id> stores the per-clone choice under local/ and refuses a closed Intent; with exactly one open Intent it is used automatically; with several open and none chosen, Intent-scoped commands fail listing the open Intents; --intent <id> overrides on any Intent-scoped command; greatest-id selection is gone.
assignment list defaults to the active Intent (with a flag or --intent for others).
SessionStart names every open Intent (id, revision, objective, open-Assignment count) and marks the one in use; rows shrink inside the budget.
continue-work asks which Intent to continue when several are open; the assignments skill documents the new commands.
README: new commands and states, local/.gitignore, collaborators need the same version because older versions reject the new fields, existing Intents read as open until closed.
Regression tests for each behavior fail on the base; format, lint, typecheck, test pass; bundle rebuilt with Bun 1.4.3.
